result.summary: The intersection is equipped with high-visibility continental crosswalks and pedestrian signals, providing a basic level of safety. However, the wide roadway creates a long crossing distance without a median refuge, increasing pedestrian exposure to traffic.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The width of the roadway increases the time pedestrians are exposed to vehicle traffic while crossing.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main intersection in the foreground

hazards.name: Wide Turning Radii
hazards.description: The corner geometry allows vehicles to make right turns at higher speeds, increasing risk to pedestrians in the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Construct a raised median island to provide a safe waiting area for pedestrians mid-crossing.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles receive a green light.

result.summary: The image shows a wide, one-way urban street with multiple travel lanes and embedded tram tracks. While sidewalks and a marked crosswalk are present, the lack of pedestrian refuge islands and the long crossing distance create a high-exposure environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a refuge island, increasing exposure time.

hazards.name: Tram Tracks
hazards.description: Embedded tracks in the roadway can cause tripping or catch bicycle wheels.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Stopped Vehicle
hazards.description: The large van stopped in the roadway may block the view between pedestrians and oncoming traffic.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross in stages.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at the crossing to reduce the crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install signals that show the remaining time to cross to help pedestrians make informed decisions.

result.summary: The intersection features standard pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks and signals, but lacks advanced safety measures. The wide roadway and absence of physical separation or refuge areas increase the risk for pedestrians during crossing.

hazards.name: Extended Crossing Exposure
hazards.description: The wide intersection requires pedestrians to spend a significant amount of time in the roadway without a refuge.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection may obscure sightlines between pedestrians and turning drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image along the curb

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow for two-stage crossing on the wider street.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces closest to the crosswalk to improve visibility.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a marked crosswalk and a raised transit platform that functions as a refuge island, providing some protection. However, the wide roadway and presence of embedded rail tracks increase exposure and potential tripping hazards for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Embedded Rail Tracks
hazards.description: The light rail tracks embedded in the roadway present a tripping hazard for pedestrians and can catch bicycle tires.
hazards.location_in_image: Center and right side of the roadway, running parallel to traffic

hazards.name: Unsignalized Wide Crossing
hazards.description: The marked crosswalk lacks visible pedestrian signals, requiring pedestrians to judge gaps in traffic across multiple lanes.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground left, crossing the roadway to the transit platform

interventions.title: Pedestrian Hybrid Beacon
interventions.description: Install a signalized crossing to provide protected intervals for pedestrians crossing the wide roadway to reach the transit platform.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at the crosswalk to reduce the crossing distance and improve the visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Upgrade the existing transverse markings to high-visibility continental markings to increase driver awareness.
